title: The 5 Tallest Statues on Earth, Ranked (All Five Are in Asia)

scenes.text: The five tallest statues on Earth all stand on one continent. Only one is taller than 150 meters.

scenes.label: Ushiku Daibutsu · 100 m
scenes.text: Number five: Ushiku Daibutsu, in Japan. A Buddha about one hundred meters tall, finished in 1993.

scenes.label: Statue of Belief · 106 m
scenes.text: Number four: the Statue of Belief, in Rajasthan, India. A Shiva one hundred and six meters tall, finished in 2020.

scenes.label: Laykyun Sekkya · 116 m
scenes.text: Number three: Laykyun Sekkya, in Myanmar. A standing Buddha about one hundred and sixteen meters tall, finished in 2008.

scenes.label: Spring Temple Buddha · 128 m
scenes.text: Number two: the Spring Temple Buddha, in China. One hundred and twenty-eight meters, standing on a pedestal that adds eighty more.

scenes.label: Statue of Unity · 182 m
scenes.text: Number one: the Statue of Unity, in India. One hundred and eighty-two meters, finished in 2018, and it honors Vallabhbhai Patel.

description:
The five tallest statues on Earth, ranked by statue height without the pedestal.
All five stand in Asia, and number one, the Statue of Unity in India, is 182 meters tall, finished in 2018.
Which one would you most want to visit?
first_comment: Which of these would you most want to see in person? And what should we rank next?
